description: Two ships on a dark, stormy sea under a heavy sky. In the foreground, a paddle-wheel steamer with a tall smokestack and two masts, smoke and sparks pouring from the funnel, heads right with waves breaking around its hull. Behind it on the left, a larger three-masted ship with black sails and a dark hull, also trailing smoke. A distant coastline with hills sits at the right edge. Painterly oil style, no visible text, no frame.
